name: webhook-fan-out
description: Deliver one event to several webhook subscribers in parallel with independent retry budgets; a best-effort subscriber is isolated behind try/catch so it cannot fail the run.
author: orch8-io
requires: context.data: event_id, event_type, crm_webhook_url, analytics_webhook_url, partner_webhook_url.
Receivers should deduplicate on the x-event-id header: retries can redeliver an event.
Built-in http_request branches are dispatched one at a time per instance (they interleave, not run concurrently); see Parallel in docs/SEQUENCES.md.
